def classify(torch,standing,pure,moving,transition,command,signed_yaw):
    assert not bool((standing&(pure|moving)).any()) and not bool((pure&moving).any())
    assert not bool((transition&~pure).any())
    key=torch.full_like(signed_yaw,-1,dtype=torch.long)
    key[standing]=0
    straight=~(standing|pure|moving)
    key[straight&(command[:,0]<0)]=1;key[straight&(command[:,0]==0)]=2;key[straight&(command[:,0]>0)]=3
    key[pure&~transition&(signed_yaw<0)]=4;key[pure&~transition&(signed_yaw>0)]=5
    key[transition&(signed_yaw<0)]=6;key[transition&(signed_yaw>0)]=7
    key[moving&(signed_yaw<0)]=8;key[moving&(signed_yaw>0)]=9
    assert bool((key>=0).all()),'Unclassified actual E0 command flags; no silent profile replacement'
    return key

class E0Book:
    def __init__(self,t,n,device,reasons):
        self.t=t;self.n=n;self.ids=t.arange(n,device=device);self.reasons=tuple(reasons)

        self.cycle_nominal_abs_distance=t.zeros_like(self.cycle_seconds);self.cycle_reference_abs_distance=t.zeros_like(self.cycle_seconds)
        self.maxlive=t.zeros_like(self.cycle_seconds)
        self.phase_count=t.zeros((2,9,2,n),device=device,dtype=t.long)
        self.phase_error=t.zeros((2,3,9,2,n),device=device)
        self.prev_key=t.full((n,),-1,device=device,dtype=t.long);self.prev_episode=self.prev_key.clone();self.prev_command=self.prev_key.clone()
        self.prev_live=t.zeros(n,device=device,dtype=t.bool);self.prev_phase=-1
        self.age=t.zeros(n,device=device);self.turn=self.age.clone();self.elapsed=self.age.clone();self.ref_distance=self.age.clone()
        self.start_xy=t.zeros((n,2),device=device)

    def observe(self,c,after,terminated,truncated,reason_masks):
        t=self.t;key=c['key'];phase=c['phase'];idx=(key,self.ids);live=~(terminated|truncated)
        assert bool(((key>=0)&(key<10)).all()) and key.shape==(self.n,)
        self.count[phase][idx]+=1
        for j,error in enumerate(after['errors']):
            assert error.shape==(self.n,) and bool(t.isfinite(error).all())
            self.errors[phase,j][idx]+=error

        for j,mask in enumerate(reason_masks):self.reason[phase,j][idx]+=mask.long()
        same=(key==self.prev_key)&(c['episode']==self.prev_episode)&(c['command_uid']==self.prev_command)&self.prev_live
        if phase!=self.prev_phase:same=t.zeros_like(same)
        self.age=t.where(same,self.age+.02,t.full_like(self.age,.02))
        self.maxlive[phase][idx]=t.maximum(self.maxlive[phase][idx],t.where(live,self.age,t.zeros_like(self.age)))
        self.start_xy=t.where(same[:,None],self.start_xy,c['before_xy'])
        self.turn=t.where(same,self.turn+after['heading_delta'],after['heading_delta'])

        active=((key==4)|(key==5)|(key==8)|(key==9))&live

    def begin(self,control,c,physics_tick):
        for name in ('key','episode','command_uid'):
            if c[name].shape!=(self.n,) or c[name].dtype!=self.t.long:
                raise ValueError('Original E2 UID/profile schema mismatch: '+name)
        if self.last_physics_tick is not None and physics_tick!=self.last_physics_tick:
            raise ValueError('Missing original consecutive E2 physical control interval')
        self.control=int(control)
        valid=(c['key']==8)|(c['key']==9)
        same=(self.key==c['key'])&(self.episode==c['episode'])&(self.uid==c['command_uid'])
        same&=(self.direction==c['direction'])&(self.sign==self.t.sign(c['signed_yaw']))
        self.close(self.ids[self.active&(~valid|~same)],'original_UID_episode_profile_direction_sign_change')
        ids=self.ids[valid&~self.active]
        self.active[ids]=True;self.key[ids]=c['key'][ids];self.episode[ids]=c['episode'][ids]
        self.uid[ids]=c['command_uid'][ids];self.direction[ids]=c['direction'][ids]
        self.sign[ids]=self.t.sign(c['signed_yaw'][ids]);self.controls[ids]=0
        self.first_control[ids]=control;self.last_control[ids]=control-1
        self.first_phase[ids]=c['phase'];self.cross_phase[ids]=False
        self.term[ids]=False;self.timeout[ids]=False
        for value in (self.turn,self.cross,self.along,self.command_yaw,self.reference):value[ids]=0

        t=self.t
        if int(physics_end_tick)!=self.begin_tick+8:

        self.last_physics_tick=int(physics_end_tick)

        ids=self.ids[self.active]

        else:self.partial+=len(ids)

        ids=ids[self.active[ids]];self.emit(ids,False,reason);self.active[ids]=False

        self.close(self.ids,'window_end_partial');producer=self.writer.finish()

def classify(torch,standing,pure,moving,transition,command,signed_yaw):
    assert not bool((standing&(pure|moving)).any()) and not bool((pure&moving).any())
    assert not bool((transition&~pure).any())
    key=torch.full_like(signed_yaw,-1,dtype=torch.long)
    key[standing]=0
    straight=~(standing|pure|moving)
    key[straight&(command[:,0]<0)]=1;key[straight&(command[:,0]==0)]=2;key[straight&(command[:,0]>0)]=3
    key[pure&~transition&(signed_yaw<0)]=4;key[pure&~transition&(signed_yaw>0)]=5
    key[transition&(signed_yaw<0)]=6;key[transition&(signed_yaw>0)]=7
    key[moving&(signed_yaw<0)]=8;key[moving&(signed_yaw>0)]=9
    assert bool((key>=0).all()),'Unclassified actual E2 command flags; no silent profile replacement'
    return key

class Step270Events:
    """Fresh ground-only episodes; success requires an actual top-surface hit.

    Runtime adapter admission is intentionally absent. Callers must provide
    proven authored collider footprint/edge crossings and platform contact IDs.
    Test fixtures are not simulation results and cannot admit a GPU launch.
    """
    def __init__(self,n,device='cpu',contract=Contract()):
        self.c=contract
        if contract.platform_top_m<.270:raise ValueError('Human minimum is 270mm')
        if contract.physics_dt_s!=.0025:raise ValueError('Unqualified physical clock')
        self.ready_ticks=torch.zeros(n,dtype=torch.long,device=device)
        self.air_ticks=self.ready_ticks.clone();self.land_ticks=self.ready_ticks.clone();self.stable_ticks=self.ready_ticks.clone()
        self.attempt=torch.zeros(n,dtype=torch.bool,device=device)
        self.launched=self.attempt.clone();self.edge=self.attempt.clone();self.landed=self.attempt.clone();self.success=self.attempt.clone()
        self.positive_vz=self.attempt.clone();self.progress=torch.zeros(n,device=device)

    def physical(self,*,request,ground_ready,nonwheel_clean,known_integrity,
                 wheel_N,wheel_bottom_world_z,wheel_contact_platform,
                 wheel_footprints_inside_top,both_wheel_edge_crossed,
                 root_vz,planar_speed,roll,pitch,heading_error):
        c=self.c
        if not known_integrity.all():raise ValueError('unknown/integrity rejection')
        for v in (wheel_N,wheel_bottom_world_z,root_vz,planar_speed,roll,pitch,heading_error):
            if not torch.isfinite(v).all():raise ValueError('nonfinite task witness')
        self.ready_ticks=torch.where(ground_ready&~request,self.ready_ticks+1,0)
        ready=self.ready_ticks>=c.ready_callbacks
        # Preserve previously obtained readiness at request edge, no air reset.
        if not hasattr(self,'was_ready'):self.was_ready=ready.clone()
        self.attempt|=request&self.was_ready
        self.was_ready=torch.where(request,self.was_ready,ready)
        self.positive_vz|=self.attempt&(root_vz>.05)
        air=self.attempt&self.positive_vz&(wheel_N<=c.support_N).all(-1)&nonwheel_clean
        self.air_ticks=torch.where(air,self.air_ticks+1,0)
        takeoff=(self.air_ticks>=c.air_callbacks)&~self.launched;self.launched|=takeoff
        actual_clear=(wheel_bottom_world_z>=c.platform_top_m).all(-1)
        self.edge|=self.launched&air&both_wheel_edge_crossed&actual_clear
        eligible=self.launched&air&nonwheel_clean
        peak=(wheel_bottom_world_z.amin(-1)/c.platform_top_m).clamp(0,1)
        next_progress=torch.maximum(self.progress,torch.where(eligible,peak,0))
        progress_delta=next_progress-self.progress;self.progress=next_progress
        on_top=(wheel_N>c.support_N).all(-1)&wheel_contact_platform.all(-1)&wheel_footprints_inside_top.all(-1)&(wheel_bottom_world_z>=c.platform_top_m-c.geometry_skin_m).all(-1)&nonwheel_clean
        self.land_ticks=torch.where(self.edge&on_top,self.land_ticks+1,0)
        landing=(self.land_ticks>=c.landing_callbacks)&~self.landed;self.landed|=landing
        yaw=torch.atan2(torch.sin(heading_error),torch.cos(heading_error))
        stable=self.landed&on_top&(root_vz.abs()<=c.stable_speed_m_s)&(planar_speed<=c.stable_speed_m_s)&(roll.abs()<c.stable_tilt_rad)&(pitch.abs()<c.stable_tilt_rad)&(yaw.abs()<c.stable_yaw_rad)
        self.stable_ticks=torch.where(stable,self.stable_ticks+1,0)
        recovered=(self.stable_ticks>=c.stable_callbacks)&~self.success;self.success|=recovered
        return dict(takeoff=takeoff,edge_cleared=self.edge.clone(),landing=landing,recovery=recovered,success=self.success.clone(),wheel_clearance_progress_delta=progress_delta)
